expert_translation: He looks after his money the way storks pursue locusts.
expert_cultural_meaning: Whoever has much always wants more.
expert_teaching: It teaches that lack of satisfaction with what one has, leads to greed and hunger for more money. It also creates mistrust, such that the person becomes possessive.
